Dear Hiring Team,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with me about the Machine Learning Intern position at Bluepeak AI. I appreciated the opportunity to learn more about the team and your work.

Our conversation reinforced my enthusiasm for the role. Through my background in statistics and my experience analyzing canteen sales using Python and pandas to reduce waste by 15 percent, I am eager to contribute analytical skills to your projects.

Thank you again for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you regarding the next steps.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
